Exceptions

Even when a statement is syntactically correct, it may cause an error.

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
ZeroDivisionError: division by zero

Exception details

The final line identifies the exception type and message.

Handling Exceptions

The try statement handles selected exceptions.

  • First, execute the try clause.
  • If an exception occurs, select a matching handler.
